The '''Butterfly Hutch''' is a piece of [[furniture]]. It can be purchased from the [[Desert Trader]] for 200 [[Bat Wing]]s. 

Placing the Butterfly Hutch inside any building will cause butterflies to fly around inside. It cannot be interacted with.

==History==
{{History|1.4|Introduced.}}
{{History|1.5|Can now be placed anywhere. Butterflies will appear if it is placed anywhere indoors.}}
